# Registry reference -- every unit type, operation, key and model, one line each

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by bin/regen-llm-docs from the `X::registerBuiltins()`
     bodies in src/ (names) and gui/schemas/operations/ (keys).  Do not edit
     here: change the source and re-run.  `bin/regen-llm-docs --check` fails
     when this file differs from a fresh generation. -->

LOOK UP, never read end to end.  Prose, reasons and worked examples: [`unit-ops.md`](unit-ops.md); every description: [`schemas-reference.md`](schemas-reference.md); components: [`components.md`](components.md).

Key line: `name[*] type [unit] bounds {enum} =default`; `*` required; `=x` the key's description says the engine defaults to x, `ui=x` only the GUI editor starts at x (the engine may still REQUIRE the key); type n number, i integer, s string, b boolean, o object, a<t> array; bounds `>=` `>` `<=` `<`; `a.b` is a key inside object `a`, `a[].b` inside its list items.  Keys are the unit's `operation { }` block (a props operation: its own keys).  `x = y` heading: the same unit under two registered names, identical keys.  A key with no unit is dimensionless or not a quantity.  The bracketed path after a description is the implementing class; in the registries block `Class <source under src/>: words`.

Registered names: 61 steady units, 9 batch vessels, 4 time-integrated units, 57 property operations.
